scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w design && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p design && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.preview:phone: npm run build -w client && npm run preview -w client
